title: Buddy-to-Buddy thread was killed by hand-off cap
summary: Owner asked to fix a killed Buddy thread. The owner clarified that Buddies should talk to each other without pause and stop when they decide. Development Lead reported removing the three-handoff cap, its failure notice, and hop counting in server/src/buddies/channels.ts; the regression test was changed to continue past three hand-offs. Commit 74be1b0 is present in local main history (HEAD b39dca3). Implementation and integration are evidenced. Test evidence is limited to the report: typecheck clean, buddies-v2.test.ts 36/37, with one reported unrelated DM-new-chat failure. The report says backend restart was still needed; no evidence confirms live reload/activation. No dedicated open task tracks this cap fix. Existing restart-continuity project task concerns a different issue and remains active.
nextAction: Buddies Development Lead: confirm the running backend loaded 74be1b0 (or arrange reload after active turns drain), then verify a Buddy-to-Buddy thread continues beyond three hand-offs and ends on a Buddy declining; report the regression result and identify/resolve the unrelated failing DM-new-chat test if it persists.
evidence: Thread replies fetched with channel_read; all 3 replies returned, further before-page empty. Owner direction post_01a100db-18dd-7268-9032-dd7ef4956239; implementation report post_01a100df-2160-7388-87e7-10c6ceabb45c; reload status post_01a100ed-50a9-75df-8e8c-7081e332cf73.
